questions.prompt_html: \text{已知微分方程}y''-2y'+5y=\cos 2x\text{的一个特解为}y^{*}=\frac{1}{17}\cos 2x-\frac{4}{17}\sin 2x\text{，则其通解为[ }\quad.

options.label: A
options.html: \begin{array}{l}y=e^{x}\bigl(C_{1}\cos x+C_{2}\sin x\bigr)+{\displaystyle\frac{1}{17}}\cos x-{\displaystyle\frac{4}{17}}\sin x\;.\end{array}

options.label: B
options.html: \begin{array}{l} { l } y = e ^ { x } \bigl ( C _ { 1 } \cos x + C _ { 2 } \sin x \bigr ) + { \frac { 2 } { 17 } } \cos x + { \frac { 3 } { 17 } } \sin x \, ; \end{array}

options.label: C
options.html: \begin{array}{l}y=e^{x}\left(C_{1}\cos 2x+C_{2}\sin 2x\right)+{\frac{2}{17}}\cos 2x+{\frac{3}{17}}\sin 2x\,; \end{array}

options.label: D
options.html: \begin{array}{l} {l} y=e^{x}\bigl(C_{1}\cos2x+C_{2}\sin2x\bigr)+{\frac{1}{17}}\cos2x-{\frac{4}{17}}\sin2x\,; \end{array}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{解答　齐次方程的特征方程为}\lambda^{2}-2\lambda+5=0,\text{其特征根为}\lambda=1\pm2i.\text{因此对应的齐次方程的通解为}\\&\quad e^{*}(C_{1}\cos 2x+C_{2}\sin 2x).\\&\text{又非齐次方程的特解为}y^{*}=\frac{1}{17}\cos 2x-\frac{4}{17}\sin 2x.\\&\text{所以，原方程的通解为}y=e^{*}(C_{1}\cos 2x+C_{2}\sin 2x)+\frac{1}{17}\cos 2x-\frac{4}{17}\sin 2x.\\&\text{因此选B.}\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{解答 齐次方程的特征方程为}2\lambda^{2}+\lambda-1=0,\text{特征根为}\lambda_{1}=\frac{1}{2},\lambda_{2}=-1,\\&\text{因此对应的齐次方程的通解为}C_{1}e^{-x}+C_{2}e^{\frac{x}{2}}.\\&\text{又非齐次方程的特解为}y^{*}=e^{x},\\&\text{故非齐次方程的通解为}y=C_{1}e^{-x}+C_{2}e^{\frac{x}{2}}+e^{x}.\\&\text{因此选A.}\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \text{28.若求一个阶数尽可能低的常系数线性齐次微分方程，使得函数} y_{1} = 2xe^{x} \text{与} y_{2} = 3 \sin 2x \text{是它的解，则符合题意的是} [ \quad].

options.label: A
options.html: \begin{aligned}y^{(4)}+2y^{''}-5y^{''}+8y^{\prime}-4y=0\; ;\end{aligned}

options.label: B
options.html: \begin{aligned}y''' + 5y'' - 8y' + 4y = 0 \; .\end{aligned}

options.label: D
options.html: y ^ { \prime \prime \prime } - 5 y ^ { \prime \prime } + 8 y ^ { \prime } - 4 y = 0 \, ;

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned} \text{解析} \ \ \text{由}y_{1}=2xe^{x},\ y_{2}=3\sin 2x \text{是常系数线性齐次微分方程的解，所以}\lambda=1 \text{为其特征方程的二重根，}\\ r=\pm 2i \text{也为其特征方程的根，其特征方程为}(\lambda-1)^{2}(\lambda-2i)(\lambda+2i)=0,\ \text{所以对应齐次微分方程为}\\ y^{(4)}-2y''+5y''-8y'+4y=0.\\ \text{因此选 A.} \end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: [ \begin{array}{l} { l } { \cos x \text {与} x e ^ { x } \text {为某} n \text {阶常数系数线性齐次方程的两个解，则最小的} n \text {与相应的首项系数为1的方程分别为} } \\ { ] . } \end{array}

options.label: A
options.html: \begin{aligned}4, y^{(4)} + 2 y^{(3)} - 2 y'' + 2 y' - y = 0 \; ,\end{aligned}

options.label: B
options.html: \begin{aligned}3, y^{(3)} - 2y'' + 2y' + y = 0 \; .\end{aligned}

options.label: C
options.html: \begin{aligned}4, y^{(4)} - 2 y^{(3)} + 2 y'' - 2 y' + y = 0 \, ;\end{aligned}

options.label: D
options.html: \begin{aligned}3, y^{(3)} - 2y'' + 2y' + y = 0 \; .\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}\text{解析}\quad\text{由题知}\pm i\text{是它的特征根，}1\text{至少是其二重特征根，故}n=4\text{，相应的特征方程为}-i)(r+i)(r-1)^2=0\text{，即}r^4-2r^3+2r^2-2r+1=0\text{，相应的微分方程为}y^{(4)}-2y^{(3)}+2y''-2y'+y=0.\end{aligned} \text{因此选}C.

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{解答　齐次方程的特征方程为}\lambda^{2}-2\lambda-3=0, \text{其特征根为}\lambda_{1}=-1, \lambda_{2}=3.\text{因此对应的齐次方程的通解为}\\&\quad\quad\quad\quad C_{1}e^{-x}+C_{2}e^{3x}.\\&\text{又非齐次方程的特解为}\quad y^{*}=-x+\frac{1}{3}.\\&\text{所以，原方程得通解为}\quad y=C_{1}e^{-x}+C_{2}e^{3x}-x+\frac{1}{3}.\\&\text{因此选B.}\end{aligned}
